statement.zh: Lloyd & Safar 1943 报告伊拉克古物局在乌盖尔的发掘，包括欧贝德聚落、乌鲁克彩绘神庙与早王朝墓地等语境。
statement.en: Lloyd & Safar 1943 report Iraqi Directorate excavations at Tell Uqair, including Ubaid settlement, an Uruk painted temple, and Early Dynastic cemetery contexts.
